title: Negotiating Conditions and Tradeoffs
summary: Clarifying interests, proposing conditional concessions, and documenting negotiated agreements.
whyItMatters: Effective negotiation converts positions into underlying interests and trades concessions across issues without creating hidden ambiguity.

mentalModel.title: Interests lie beneath positions
mentalModel.content: A demand such as a lower price may reflect budget limits, risk, predictability, or internal approval requirements.

mentalModel.title: Concessions should be conditional
mentalModel.content: Link what you can offer to what you need in return instead of conceding one point at a time.

ruleBlocks.title: Clarify priorities and constraints
ruleBlocks.content: Ask which conditions are essential, flexible, or dependent on another term.

ruleBlocks.title: Negotiate packages
ruleBlocks.content: Combine price, volume, delivery, service, duration, and standards into comparable options.

ruleBlocks.title: Confirm the agreement explicitly
ruleBlocks.content: Restate responsibilities, deadlines, exceptions, review points, and unresolved issues.

tables.title: Negotiation Toolkit
rows: Worauf kommt es Ihnen dabei besonders an?
Unter der Voraussetzung, dass ..., könnten wir ...
Wenn Sie ..., wären wir im Gegenzug bereit, ...

examples.de: Unter der Voraussetzung, dass die Lieferfrist garantiert wird, könnten wir eine größere Menge abnehmen.
examples.en: Provided that the delivery deadline is guaranteed, we could purchase a larger quantity.

examples.de: Wenn Sie beim Preis entgegenkommen, wären wir im Gegenzug zu einer längeren Laufzeit bereit.
examples.en: If you accommodate us on price, we would in return accept a longer term.

examples.de: Halten wir fest, dass die neuen Standards ab September für alle Zulieferer gelten.
examples.en: Let us record that the new standards apply to all suppliers from September.

commonMistakes.wrong: Defend a fixed position without asking why it matters.
commonMistakes.correct: Identify interests and constraints before proposing options.
commonMistakes.reason: Different positions may still permit compatible solutions.

commonMistakes.wrong: End with a general expression of agreement.

comparisons.summary: The theme provides realistic tensions among cost, resilience, standards, and dependency.
Function-verb structures support formal proposals and precise summaries.
